title: Action-Conditioned Progressive Evidence Commitment
hypothesis: A truth-free ambiguity trigger followed by one fixed local observation action recovers the correct facade and entrance more efficiently than passive accumulation or the same action on every eligible step.

arms.PASSIVE: Accumulate currently available progressive evidence without requesting an extra observation action.
arms.FIXED_ACTION: Request the same frozen local sidestep, pan, or approach action at every eligible decision point.
arms.TRIGGERED_ACTION: Request that same frozen local action only when a truth-free ambiguity trigger fires.

allowed_inputs: action receipt and expected readability change

authority_reducer.distance_rule: Distance and pose bins are analysis variables only and cannot grant, retain, or revoke authority.

required_controls: same_scene sibling facade or sibling entrance
stop_conditions: Source admission fails any required pose, action, facade, entrance, sibling, ownership, or handoff field.
Any runtime arm reads evaluator-private truth.
The fixed action differs between FIXED_ACTION and TRIGGERED_ACTION.
Distance or visual scale is used as an authority transition threshold.
Wrong-target commit is not measurable on the admitted sequence.
claim_boundary: A positive result may establish Development evidence that one truth-free trigger plus one fixed local action causally improves correct facade or entrance recovery on the admitted sequence. It cannot establish a learned action selector, general navigation, public access, walkability, collision-free motion, arrival, user benefit, safety, deployment, or universal distance behavior. Existing consumed progressive replay, FSNS, CATALIST, PanoLab entrance rays, physical-door instance heads, and registered portal geometry do not substitute for this sequence.
